calculation.description: Ranks tradable assets by lower trailing 60-session realized volatility, with the complete signal lagged one completed session to avoid look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Long sample passes gates, with positive 2027 IC 0.129143, but weak 2024 (-0.014822), 2030 (-0.005143), 2031-2032 (-0.089718), and sharply negative 2033 YTD (-0.151813 across 33 dates). Interpret recent drift conservatively.
validation.methodology: Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC against forward close-to-close returns; minimum 8 valid instruments per date; 15-instrument universe; no future data used.
